bundle.shortDescription: Desktop app for tuning and testing local Ollama models
bundle.longDescription: Remuda pairs a chat pane with the loaded model's Modelfile editor, so testing a model and tuning it happen in one window. Editing the system prompt or a parameter rebuilds and reloads the model, and the next message uses the change. Includes A/B compare on a pinned seed, Modelfile history with diffs, and a tool-calling playground. Remuda is a client for a local Ollama install; it does not bundle or run inference itself.
